_comment: Sprint D9 — stress load scenario. Cf. d9_deep_analysis_supplement.md §1.3 (capacity math). 16 concurrent clients pushes the system into the saturation regime to expose queue-depth p99 explosion. Duration 2 min keeps CI cost bounded (~400 samples post-skip).
_saturation_target: Goal RPS=30 exceeds single-replica λ_max ≈ 6.4 RPS @ c=16 (Little's law, supplement §3.2). Expect either: (a) HPA scales out → throughput approaches 30 RPS, or (b) error rate climbs as the rate limit / queue depth saturates. Both are valid outcomes — the SLO `D9-LOAD-3` only requires ≥ 5 RPS sustained throughput.
